newsitem.title: GERMANY: Danzas names German logistics manager.
newsitem.headline: Danzas names German logistics manager.

text.p: Danzas GmbH, the Germany division of Swiss freight forwarder Danzas AG, said it has appointed Michael Walzer as logistics manager.
Frankfurt-based Walzer will be responsible for all European logistics and outsourcing projects, a company statement said.
Danzas has carried out tailor-made logistics projects for IBM, BASF and Daimler-Benz Aerospace in recent years, the statement said.

Walzer was previously manager of a consulting firm and sales manager of German logistics company Fiege Logistik GmbH, it added. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
